sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'array' THEN (p.traits -> $2::text) ?| $3::text[] END), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'array' THEN (p.traits -> $2::text) ?& $4::text[] END), false) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 0 END), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false)))
